title: OL Mauigoa: Facing Bain, Mesidor fueled growth

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: OL Mauigoa: Facing Bain, Mesidor fueled growth
sources.description: Francis Mauigoa, the top OL prospect in the NFL draft, said he's open to a position change. and said daily battles with Miami teammates Reuben Bain Jr. and Akheem Mesidor made him better.
